text: Very weak  and spokes fall out if you touch the rack. Not functional. We have had this a few years: buyer beware as you can’t move it or touch it once it is in place..the spokes just fall off and pain in the neck to put back in.  In fact, more a shoe display than a functional shoe rack.  We are looking for a new rack where the spokes can be screwed in place.  Yeah easy to assemble, also easy to fall apart.
